lines.zh: 我拎着刀走路，刀鞘一直晃。
lines.en: I walk with the sword, and its sheath keeps swaying.

lines.zh: 我走得有点懒，步子拖着地面。
lines.en: I walk lazily, dragging my feet a little.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边东张西望。
lines.en: I look this way and that as I walk.

lines.zh: 我挑平坦的路走，石头太硌脚。
lines.en: I take the flat road; stones hurt my feet.

lines.zh: 我往后退了两步，又往前走一步。
lines.en: I back up two paces, then take one forward.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过，前面有岔口。
lines.en: I know this road; there is a fork ahead.

lines.zh: 我把刀换到另一只手上。
lines.en: I shift the sword to my other hand.

lines.zh: 我脚步很轻，随时能转身跑。
lines.en: My steps are light, ready to turn and run.
I skirt that pile of loose rock.

lines.zh: 我走过草丛，裤脚全湿了。
lines.en: I cross the wet grass and my cuffs soak through.
I ease back behind a tree.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可我一直留意身后。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, but I keep watching behind me.

lines.zh: 我站着，手一直搭在刀柄上。
lines.en: I stand with a hand resting on the hilt.

lines.zh: 我往后退了半步，才觉得安心。
lines.en: I step back half a pace before I feel safe.

lines.zh: 我在想怎么才能不被打。
lines.en: I am thinking how to avoid getting hit.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看天，又看看地。
lines.en: I look at the sky, then at the ground.
I am a little hungry, and that is a problem.
I wipe down the sheath.
I lean on a tree and keep very quiet.
I am sizing up how strong the other one is.

lines.zh: 我的腿其实已经在发软了。
lines.en: My legs are already going weak, honestly.

lines.zh: 我深吸一口气，又慢慢吐出来。
lines.en: I take a deep breath and let it out slowly.
At times like this, hiding is best.

lines.zh: 我听见风声，就缩了一下。
lines.en: A gust of wind makes me flinch.

lines.zh: 我把重心放到后脚，方便退。
lines.en: I put my weight on the back foot, ready to retreat.

lines.zh: 我这一身本领，多半用来跑。
lines.en: Most of my skill goes into running.

lines.zh: 我看你一眼，又赶紧移开。
lines.en: I glance at you and quickly look away.
You are taller than me; that is not good.

lines.zh: 我的手在刀柄上捏紧了。
lines.en: My hand tightens on the hilt.
If you mean to fight, say so first.

lines.zh: 我脸上堆着笑，心里在算退路。
lines.en: I smile while working out my escape.
I cannot read your ki at all.
I do not start trouble; do not start it with me.
I am a coward, and I am not ashamed of it.
Go if you are going; I will not stop you.
I draw the sword an inch out.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚后跟碰到石头。
lines.en: I step back and my heel hits a stone.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，尽量显得不慌。
lines.en: I lift my head and try to look unafraid.
What are you smiling at? I do not like it.
Why do we not each go our own way?
My voice comes out a little shaky.

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，叹了口气。
lines.en: I look at you once and sigh.
I yelp and spring backward.
The pain makes me suck in air.
I press a hand to the wound.
I retreat several steps.
My face screws up.
This is bad; truly bad.
I clench my teeth, legs shaking.

lines.zh: 我这条命还得留着吃饭。
lines.en: I still need this life to eat with.
I wipe my face and my hand comes away red.

lines.zh: 我开始后悔站在这儿了。
lines.en: I am starting to regret standing here.

lines.zh: 吃的？你怎么知道我好这个。
lines.en: Food? How did you know that about me?
I smell it; that is meat.
With a bite of this, everything is negotiable.

lines.zh: 我咽了一下口水，很大声。
lines.en: I swallow, and it is loud.

lines.zh: 你早说啊，我还能帮你抬东西。
lines.en: You should have said so; I could even help carry things.
I reach and grab it; no more pretending.

lines.zh: 这么香的东西，值得跑一趟。
lines.en: Something this good is worth the trip.
I take a bite first; do not snatch it.
The sword can go down for now.

lines.zh: 我一下被撞得坐在地上。
lines.en: The bump sits me right on the ground.

lines.zh: 我赶紧爬起来，退了两步。
lines.en: I scramble up and back off two paces.

lines.zh: 你撞我做什么，我又没动。
lines.en: Why bump me? I was not even moving.

lines.zh: 我用手护住头，缩了一下。
lines.en: I cover my head and flinch.
I do not hold steady; I wobble.
I apologize while backing away.
Do not come so close; I am not used to it.
I have retreated to the tree over there.
A knock is nothing; I am thick-skinned.
I cannot take up that topic.
A man like me? Best not.
I wave a hand, my face a bit red.
Let us talk about food first.
I slip aside.
I do not understand this at all.
I give a dry laugh.
I have things to do; I am off.
I lower my head and say nothing.
Is that not an odd thing to ask?

lines.zh: 我赶紧捡起来，塞进怀里。
lines.en: I snatch it up and stuff it inside my robe.
This could buy me a meal.
I look; it is worth little.

lines.zh: 我把它放回去，不是我的。
lines.en: I put it back; it is not mine.
I will keep this; it is useful.

lines.zh: 我边捡边看四周，怕人看见。
lines.en: I pick it up while glancing around.
Too heavy; I cannot carry it.
What I pick up is mine.

lines.zh: 我看到了，也做好了退的准备。
lines.en: I see it, and I am ready to fall back.

lines.zh: 我的手已经把刀抽出来了。
lines.en: My sword is already out of the sheath.

lines.zh: 你非要打，那我也没办法。
lines.en: If you insist on fighting, I have no choice.

lines.zh: 我先看准了逃跑的方向。
lines.en: I have already picked my escape route.
My legs shake, but the blade does not.

lines.zh: 你们这些人，怎么都不讲理。
lines.en: Why is no one here reasonable?
I back away with my eyes on you.

lines.zh: 真打起来，我可不会死撑。
lines.en: If it comes to it, I will not die for pride.

lines.zh: 我深吸一口气，把刀举起来。
lines.en: I take a breath and raise the blade.
Can I not get out of this one?
I crouch low, ready to slip.
If you really chase, I really run.
There is no one here but me.
I grit my teeth and plant my feet.

lines.zh: 这一刀下去，我可不负责。
lines.en: If this blade lands, it is not my fault.
Afraid as I am, my hands are steady enough.
I watch you as I retreat.
I head where the trees are thick.
I need not win; I only need to get away.
I move along with my back to the wall.

lines.zh: 你追得越紧，我跑得越快。
lines.en: The harder you chase, the faster I go.
My feet slip a little.
This path leads down the slope; I know it.

lines.zh: 你别过来，我刀可不长眼。
lines.en: Stay back; this blade has no eyes.
I plant on a stone and vault over.
I am gasping hard, but I do not stop.
I hold the blade across in front of me.
I duck under the shrubs.
I am waiting for you to tire first.
I know this area very well.
I stop just long enough for one breath.
You will not catch me, truly.

lines.zh: 我一刀劈过去，手还算快。
lines.en: I slash once, and my hand is quick enough.
I cut and retreat at once, not daring to linger.
The blade lands on your shoulder.
I knock your hand aside with the flat.
I slip to your flank and cut again.

lines.zh: 我这一下是急了才出的。
lines.en: That one came out of panic.
The blade flashes and I pull back.
I miss and panic a little.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我刀法还过得去。
lines.en: Do not push me; my swordsmanship is passable.
I grit my teeth and step in again.
That cut was shallow; I drew back.
After the cut I start looking for a way out.
I am not strong, but the blade is sharp.
My hand jerks and I nearly drop the sword.
Close; you almost had me.
I poke my head out from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走出来，手按着刀。
lines.en: I come out slowly with a hand on my sword.

lines.zh: 我先看了看左右，才敢站直。
lines.en: I check both sides before straightening up.
This place does not look safe.

lines.zh: 我把刀抽出一半，又推回去。
lines.en: I draw the blade halfway, then sheathe it.

lines.zh: 我蹲在石头后面，等着看情况。
lines.en: I crouch behind a rock and wait to see.

lines.zh: 我叹了口气，还是走了过来。
lines.en: I sigh and come forward anyway.
I still smell of food.
I do not know this area; I must be careful.

lines.zh: 我站着，尽量不引人注意。
lines.en: I stand and try not to draw notice.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下来，坐了一屁股。
lines.en: I slide down the slope and land on my backside.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看天，觉得不太对。
lines.en: I look up at the sky and feel something is off.
I tighten my belt.

lines.zh: 我站定之前，先找好了退路。
lines.en: Before I settle, I locate my way out.
I am here, but I can leave at any moment.

lines.zh: 我咳了一声，把嗓子清清。
lines.en: I clear my throat.
This blade has been with me a long while.

lines.zh: 我拍着身上的火，跳了好几圈。
lines.en: I beat at the flames and hop in circles.

lines.zh: 落地时我整个人趴下去了。
lines.en: I land flat on my face.
I swallow water and flail wildly.

lines.zh: 我被炸得滚出去，耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: The blast rolls me away, ears ringing.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我腿上，我哎哟一声。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my leg and I yelp.

lines.zh: 我被一股力钉住，动不了。
lines.en: Some force pins me and I cannot move.
Hunger darkens my sight.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我头发都立了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my hair stands up.
The ground vanishes and I claw at the air.
